description.value:
Maximum HP +8 and Energy Regeneration score +2. Losing HP grants party damage +1 for 2 turns. At combat start, heal each ally for one quarter of their missing HP, rounded down, once per combat.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching preservation Path required.
